input.texture_prompt: Painted comic character matching image identity/outfit. Calm kind mature man: raised inner eyebrow ends, nearly horizontal gently arched brows, smooth unpinched glabella, no V-shaped scowl or angry crease. Soft attentive eyes, relaxed lids/cheeks/jaw, closed lips with slight friendly corners, no teeth. Keep grey hair/stubble, black beanie, lime/black windbreaker, red checked bandana, black trousers, grey chunky sneakers. Natural face proportions, upright head.
